reddit.title: Experience Smooth Transitions in Provincia's Music
reddit.body: We've improved the audio experience in Provincia! No more hard cuts between day, night, title, and combat music. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade ensures a seamless transition, enhancing your gameplay immersion. Check out the details in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
